easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Lagrella, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Lagrella until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
